title: Rekol company layer definition
description: Stored in company_layers.definition. Sits on top of a backbone (MEDDIC, BANT, SPIN or CUSTOM). evaluate.js reads it server-side with the service role; it is never sent to the browser.

context.description: Who the reps sell to and how this methodology defines a good call. Plain prose, written for the model. No customer names or personal data.

sections.description: Scored stages. Keep to 9 or fewer so the full pass stays within three batches of three under the function time limit.

evidence_rules.description: What must be in the transcript to score it, e.g. 'a number the prospect said, not the rep'.

red_flags.description: Behaviours that force amber or red.

coaching_language.description: How the coach phrases feedback, so the output sounds like them.

critical.description: If true, the deal-risk view flags deals where this stage is still red after the second call.

crm_field.description: Optional label used in the copy-to-CRM block, e.g. 'Economic buyer'.

voice.description: Tone for summaries and coaching, e.g. 'direct, encouraging, British English, no jargon'.
